name: tender-shortlist
title_zh: 按你的业务和截止日筛出可投的公开招标
tagline_zh: 招标信息散在几十个采购平台上，翻到手软还漏标。这里按国家、服务类目和投标截止日一次性拉齐。
tagline_en: Tender notices scattered across dozens of portals, easy to miss. Pull them together by country, service category.
desc_en: Find and compare public procurement opportunities with Scoutee. Use when a user wants tender discovery or a shortlist matched to their business, countries, services and deadlines.
why_zh: 先按你的业务画像做匹配再排序，不是关键词搜索堆结果；截止日近的排前面，省掉自己逐条比对资格的时间。
why_en: Matches against your business profile first, then ranks by proximity of deadline, instead of dumping keyword search hits for you.
limit_zh: 数据只来自 Scoutee 已收录的采购源，覆盖不到的平台它查不到；匹配靠你填的国家、服务类目和关键词。
limit_en: Only covers sources Scoutee has indexed; unlisted portals are invisible. Matching depends on the countries, categories and keywords you supply.
title_en: Shortlist public tenders by your business and deadline
